name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College and University Students
department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
description: A merit-cum-means scholarship for students starting a regular degree. This check does not cover renewals.
benefit: The guidelines list ₹12,000 per year for the first three undergraduate years. Later-year rates depend on the course and renewal conditions.
application_window: For AY 2026–27, NSP listed 30 November 2026 as the fresh student deadline when checked on 18 November 2026. Check NSP for the current dates.

guidelines.label: Ministry of Education scheme guidelines (2022–23 onwards)

faq.label: Ministry of Education FAQ (2025–26, linked by NSP for AY 2026–27)

documents.name: Class 12 marksheet
documents.detail: Listed for fresh applicants in the Ministry FAQ, question 19.

documents.name: Family income certificate
documents.detail: Listed for fresh applicants; confirm the required format on NSP.

documents.name: Category or caste certificate
documents.detail: For reserved-category applicants only, if applicable.

documents.name: Disability certificate
documents.detail: Only if applicable. Check current NSP instructions.

steps: Check the current fresh application deadline on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and confirm you are on your board’s qualifying list.
On NSP only, complete or use your One-Time Registration (OTR). Choose your domicile state and Post-Matric, then select the PM-USP CSSS scheme.
Confirm your course and institution, including its AISHE status, with your institute nodal officer. Submit your application and required documents yourself, only on NSP.

rules.label: Recent Class 12 completion
rules.question: Did you complete Class 12 (or equivalent) in AY 2025–26, without a gap before college?
rules.hint: The fresh application is for students who went from Class 12 into the first year of college.
rules.failure: This cycle is for students who completed Class 12 in the previous academic year and started college without a gap.
rules.quote: Students who have completed Class-XII in the last Academic Year

rules.label: First year of a regular degree
rules.question: Did you start the first year of a regular undergraduate degree in AY 2026–27?
rules.hint: Diploma, distance and correspondence courses do not qualify for this check.
rules.failure: Fresh applications are for the first year of a regular degree, not diplomas or distance courses.
rules.quote: admission in 1st year of regular graduation course

rules.label: Recognised college or institution
rules.question: Is your course at an institution recognised by the relevant regulator?
rules.hint: Ask your college or institute if you are not sure.
rules.failure: The guidelines require a recognised college or institution.
rules.quote: Pursuing courses at colleges/institutions recognized by All India Council for Technical Education and respective Regulatory Bodies concerned

rules.label: Class 12 board merit list
rules.question: Are you on your board’s eligible Class 12 list for PM-USP CSSS?
rules.hint: This means above the 80th percentile in your board and stream, not 80% marks. Choose Not sure if you have not checked the list.
rules.failure: The scheme requires the qualifying board percentile and merit-list entry.
rules.quote: Students who are above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream

rules.label: Gross annual family income limit
rules.question: Is your gross parental or family income ₹4.5 lakh per year or less?
rules.hint: The limit includes exactly ₹4.5 lakh. You do not need to enter an exact income.
rules.failure: Your selected income band is above the published INR 4.5 lakh annual limit.
rules.quote: Students with gross parental/family income upto ₹ 4.5 lakh per annum

rules.label: Other scholarship or fee support
rules.question: Are you receiving another scholarship, a fee waiver, or fee reimbursement?
rules.hint: Answer based on benefits you receive, not applications you have only submitted.
rules.failure: Receiving another scholarship, fee waiver or reimbursement does not meet this condition.
rules.quote: Not availing benefit of any other merit scholarship schemes, State run scholarship schemes, fee waiver, reimbursement scheme.
